divisions.title: David
divisions.theme: The prayers and songs of Israel's king
divisions.summary: Mostly individual laments and hymns of trust, establishing the pattern of cry and confidence. Davidic authorship predominates, with the foundation laid for how Israel prays.

divisions.title: Sons of Korah & David
divisions.theme: Temple singers and the king's prayers
divisions.summary: A shift to the divine name Elohim. Includes Korahite psalms of Zion's beauty, Asaph's prophetic voice, and concludes with Solomon's prayer for the ideal king.

divisions.title: Sons of Korah & Asaph
divisions.theme: Israel's worship leaders wrestle with God
divisions.summary: Asaph wrestles with theodicy, Korah sings of Zion, and Ethan laments the broken Davidic covenant. The darkest collection, ending with unanswered questions in Psalm 89.

divisions.title: Moses & Israel
divisions.theme: From the wilderness to the reign of the LORD
divisions.summary: Answers Book III's crisis: despite exile, YHWH is king. Moses appears (Psalm 90), enthronement hymns declare God's sovereignty, and creation and history are celebrated.

divisions.title: Pilgrimage & Praise
divisions.theme: Israel returns, ascends, and praises the LORD
divisions.summary: Thanksgiving for return, the great Hallel, Songs of Ascents, Torah meditation (119), and the final Hallelujah crescendo. The Psalter ends as it must: Praise the Lord.
